requirements.value: Must hold current valid license in another state with similar scope for at least 3 years, pass exam in original state, be in good standing, no disqualifying criminal record, and no unresolved complaints or discipline (other than financial-only penalties without public harm).
requirements.quote: The individual holds a current and valid professional or occupational license or government certification in another state in a profession or occupation with a similar scope of practice ... The individual has held the professional or occupational license or government certification in the other state for at least three years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice architecture without being licensed or registered by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or offering to practice as an architect, professional engineer, land surveyor, or landscape architect when such person is not licensed or registered by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlicensed activity subjects a person to civil penalty not to exceed $2,500
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person engaging in unlicensed, uncertified, or unregistered activity shall be subject to further proceedings before the Board and the Board may impose a civil penalty not to exceed $2,500.

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of architecture' means any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures or projects, or the related equipment or accessories.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of architecture" means any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures or projects, or the related equipment or accessories.

methods_authorized.quote: any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: "Certified interior designer" means a design professional who meets the criteria of education, experience, and testing in the rendering of interior design services established by the Board through certification as an interior designer.

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Interior design" by a certified interior designer means any service rendered wherein the principles and methodology of interior design are applied in connection with the identification, research, and creative solution of problems pertaining to the function and quality of the interior environment.

design_build_authorized.quote: a contractor who is licensed pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 11 (§ 54.1-1100 et seq.) of this title shall not be required to be licensed or registered to practice in accordance with this chapter when bidding upon or negotiating design-build contracts or performing services other than architectural, engineering or land surveying services under a design-build contract.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: Nothing contained in this chapter or in the regulations of the Board shall prohibit the practice of architecture, engineering, land surveying, landscape architecture or the offering of the title of certified interior designer by any corporation, partnership, sole proprietorship, limited liability company, or other entity

continuing_education_subject_requirement.quote: The Board shall establish criteria for continuing education activities including, but not limited to (i) content and subject matter; (ii) curriculum

continuing_education_waiver_conditions.quote: The Board may grant exemptions or waive or reduce the number of continuing education hours required in cases of certified illness or undue hardship.
